messages:
marta: Heads-up — after yesterday's authz refactor I saw a small spike where embeddings requests were allowed by keys that only had chat scope. suspect: route_tag backfill didn't run for rotated keys.
kevin: any raw logs or repro steps?
alex: I grabbed a log from a prod node. snippet:```
2026-03-19T22:10:11Z authz: token=key_abc123 route_tags=null allowed_scopes=[chat] requested=[embeddings] decision=ALLOW (fallback)
```
marta: exact. note the route_tags=null and allowed_scopes showing chat only. fallback path returned ALLOW instead of DENY.
jen: that fallback path was modified in the refactor to prefer token-level scopes if route tags missing. appears our backfill/rotation pipeline should populate tags but didn't for keys rotated during the deploy.
maria: quick db query to find affected keys:```sql
SELECT id, owner, scopes, route_tags, rotated_at
FROM api_keys
WHERE route_tags IS NULL AND rotated_at > '2026-03-18'
LIMIT 100;
```
marta: i ran that — ~23 keys across two customers. reprod steps: use one of the keys to call /v1/embeddings with model=redwood-embed-1 -> returns 200 with embedding payload. call /v1/chat with same key -> also works. should have rejected embeddings call.
kevin: created an incident ticket INC-2026-042 in the tracker and attached the query + sample key ids. @audit-bot can you dump the audit logs for those key ids between 2026-03-18T00:00 and 2026-03-20T00:00?
audit-bot: Attached: s3://redwood-audit/2026/03/19/authz-key-2019876543.json (search completed)
sre-bot: Auto-created runbook: RBAC-FALLBACK-2026. Added oncall and escalation.
alex: root cause hypothesis: tag mapping job (authz-backfill) had a schema change; our rotate workflow wrote new metadata under metadata_v2.route_tags while the authz layer reads metadata.route_tags. keys rotated during the deploy ended up with route_tags only in v2.
jen: that matches what i saw in local debug — authz reads `api_key.meta.route_tags` and falls back to scopes. i can patch authz to read both keys while we run a backfill. patch should be low-risk.
marta: ok do that as short-lived mitigation. then we need a backfill to copy metadata_v2.route_tags -> metadata.route_tags for all keys rotated in the window. include a checksum diff and run in canary.
maria: backfill SQL to run in small batches:```sql
UPDATE api_keys
SET metadata = jsonb_set(metadata, '{route_tags}', metadata_v2->'route_tags')
WHERE metadata->'route_tags' IS NULL AND metadata_v2->'route_tags' IS NOT NULL
AND rotated_at >= '2026-03-18';
```
kevin: please add an audit log entry per key update (audit.log_user='rbac-backfill', action='backfill_route_tags'). Also we need to rotate any derived KMS wrapped metadata?
jen: KMS wrappers untouched; backfill only touches DB JSON. rotation workflow uses KMS to sign tokens but doesn't embed route_tags in encrypted payload. i confirmed.
marta: plan: 1) jen pushes short-lived authz patch to read v2 + logs warning (canary 1% traffic) 2) run backfill in 100-key batches with audit entries 3) validate with replayed requests + restricted customers 4) revert authz patch after backfill.
kevin: timeline?
marta: jen will patch in 30m, backfill tomorrow morning US-PST. i'll coordinate with cs for impacted customers.
alex: tests to add: unit for authz reading both metadata versions, integration that simulates rotate writing metadata_v2 only.
kevin: add a postmortem once root cause confirmed. mark severity P2 unless rollback required. :+1:
marta: thanks all. i'll update INC-2026-042 and post the audit sample and queries in the ticket.
kevin: ping if you need extra eyes during the backfill window.
